data.title: 'Nary a blip': Mike Cannon-Brookes says Atlassian is taming AI costs
data.description: As Canva struggles with rising AI bills, Atlassian told investors that Rovo AI usage will impact margins for FY27. But CEO Mike Cannon-Brookes maintains AI is the "best thing" to happen to Atlassian.
data.author: Daniel Van Boom
